verses.waradiya-l-lahu-an-shaykhi-t-tijani-c1-v: waraḍiyā llāhu ʿan shaykhī t-tijāni waman lanā ʾilayhi wasīlu kāshifu l-ghumami
waman taʿʿalaqa bil-ʾadhyāli qāṭibaha ṣubba ʿalaynā ʾilahī ʾabḥura l-ʿiṣami
wakulli man ṭalabū ṣāliḥa daʿwatinā waghayrihim min dhawī l-ʾīmāni kullihimi
fāqbal ʾilahiyā yā raḥmānu tawbatanā bil-faḍli wal-jūdi war-riḍwāni wal-karami
kadhā ʾuṣūlī waʾaḥbābī ʾuṣūluhumu ʿammimhumu rabbi taʿmīmā bidhī l-ḥikami
waman lanā muḥsinu waman nusīʾu lahu yā rabbanā rabbanā yā wāsiʿa r-ruḥumi
wamā nuʾaddī mina l-ʾadhkāri jumlatihā fāqbal lanā bihimi yā fārija l-himami
